title: 第14章 月鳞第15章 南宫
content_zh:
许星遥蹲在灵田垄沟间，指尖凝聚着灵力，正小心地为宁心草疏导肥力。
这些又被两只灵宠糟蹋了一番，他不得不调配补救用的青灵肥。
星遥！
许星遥！
林澈的声音老远就炸响在田埂上。
你先别说话。
林澈一个急刹停在田边，差点撞翻堆着的青灵肥。
他怀里抱着的银团子倒是灵活，寒月犀幼崽轻巧跃到宁心草丛中，鼻尖好奇地蹭着那些叶片。
许星遥头也不抬，继续将青灵肥滴在药草根部。
直到最后一片草叶恢复昂然姿态，他才甩了甩沾满灵泥的手。
许星遥手腕一翻，从储物袋中取出一件泛着粼粼波光的寒冰软甲。
甲身薄如蝉翼，表面流转着水纹般的灵气，在阳光下折射出冰蓝色的光晕。
给我的？林澈眼睛唰地亮了起来，像极了看到灵果的糖球。
许星遥挑了挑眉，指了指正偷偷把宁心草往身后藏的银团子：不然给这个小馋鬼吗？它穿得上吗？话音未落，银团子地吐出一截草叶，圆滚滚的身子灵活地缩到林澈腿后，只露出一双湿漉漉的大眼睛。
林澈接过软甲时指尖一颤，看似冰寒的甲胄入手竟温润如玉，内衬用某种柔韧的丝线织就，触之生温。
这是……
之前咱们一起猎的寒鳞蟒皮。
许星遥解释道，我又换了三两玄冰丝，请炼器堂的墨铁师帮忙炼制的。
说着指了指甲身内侧若隐若现的银色纹路，这些是玄冰丝织就的防护阵纹。
林澈迫不及待地套上软甲，冰蓝色的甲胄贴合身形，在阳光下流转着水波般的光泽。

他原地转了个圈，衣袂翻飞间软甲竟无半点声响。
谢了兄弟！
突然想到什么，声音陡然拔高，等等！
你用了多少贡献点请的墨铁师，那可是能炼制‘灵纹器’的二阶‘铁师’，你该不会把那些冰魄莲子……
许星遥翻手亮出一个莹白的玉匣。
透过半透明的匣壁，七枚莲子静静悬浮在寒雾中，表面凝结着细密的冰晶。
二阶灵种哪敢随便处置。
他叹了口气，指尖轻轻摩挲玉匣，现在连培育的灵池都没有，我这个一阶的灵力，连催芽都做不到。
阳光透过树影斑驳地洒在两人身上，银团子趁机又叼走一株宁心草，发出咔嚓咔嚓的脆响。
所以有个好消息！
林澈突然拍腿，快收拾东西！
执事堂刚发布下山任务——去白鹭城给城主千金治病！
许星遥皱眉：凡间城池？怎么不找当地药修？
所以才蹊跷啊。
林澈从怀里掏出任务卷轴。
光影投射中浮现几行字迹：【白鹭城主女年十六，突发癔症，见月则狂。
当地悬壶阁束手无策，疑为邪祟所侵。
酬金：三百灵石，另赠灵植培育工具一套】
灵植培育工具？许星遥猛地抓住卷轴，光影变幻间显出附加条款：若根治此症，城主愿将城中寒月井水赠予三瓶给施救者。
林澈的指尖重点在最后一行字上敲了敲：听说那口井的水，午夜能照出月魄精华。

他冲银团子努努嘴，对咱们的小家伙们可是大补。
许星遥还是问道，但城主女儿的症状……
content_en:
Xu Xingyao squatted in the ditch of the spiritual field, condensing spiritual power on his fingertips, and was carefully channeling the fertility of Ningxin grass.
These were ruined by two spiritual pets, and he had to prepare Qingling Fertilizer for remediation.
Xingyao!
Xu Xingyao!
Lin Che's voice echoed on the field ridge from afar.
Don't speak yet.
Lin Che suddenly stopped at the edge of the field, almost knocking over the pile of green fertilizer.
The silver dumpling he held in his arms was quite flexible, and the cold moon rhinoceros cub jumped lightly into the Ningxin grass, rubbing the leaves curiously with the tip of its nose.
Xu Xingyao didn't even raise his head and continued to drip Qingling Fertilizer on the roots of the medicinal herbs.
It wasn't until the last blade of grass returned to its proud posture that he shook off his hand that was stained with spiritual mud.
Xu Xingyao flipped his wrist and took out a shimmering ice soft armor from the storage bag.
The body of the armor is as thin as cicada wings, with water-like aura flowing on the surface, reflecting an icy blue halo in the sunlight.
For me? Lin Che's eyes suddenly lit up, like candy balls after seeing the spirit fruit.
Xu Xingyao raised his eyebrows and pointed at the silver dumpling that was secretly hiding Ning Xincao behind his back: Why don't you give it to this little glutton? Is it wearable? Before he finished speaking, Silver spit out a blade of grass, and his round body nimbly shrank behind Lin Che's legs, revealing only a pair of big wet eyes.
Lin Che's fingertips trembled when she took the soft armor. The seemingly cold armor was actually as warm as jade. The inner lining was woven with some kind of flexible silk thread, which felt warm to the touch.
This is...
The cold-scaled python skin we hunted together before.
Xu Xingyao explained, I changed another three taels of Xuanbing silk and asked Master Mo Tie from the weapon refining hall to help refine it.
As he spoke, he pointed to the looming silver lines on the inside of his nails. These were protective formations woven from black ice silk.
Lin Che couldn't wait to put on the soft armor. The ice blue armor fit her body perfectly and shone like water waves in the sunlight.
He spun around in a circle, his clothes and armor fluttering around without making any sound.
Thanks brother!
Suddenly something came to mind, and the voice suddenly rose in pitch, wait!
How many contribution points did you use to hire Iron Master Mo? He is a second-level 'Iron Master' who can refine 'Spirit Pattern Weapons'. You shouldn't use those Ice Soul Lotus Seeds...
Xu Xingyao turned over his hand and revealed a white jade box.
Through the translucent box wall, seven lotus seeds are quietly suspended in the cold mist, with fine ice crystals condensed on the surface.
How dare you deal with a second-level spirit seed casually?
He sighed and gently rubbed the jade box with his fingertips. Now there is no spiritual pool to cultivate. With my first-level spiritual power, I can't even induce germination.
The sun shone dappledly on the two of them through the shadows of the trees. Yin Tuanzi took the opportunity to take another Ningxin grass in his mouth, making a crunching sound.
So there is good news!
Lin Che suddenly slapped her legs, pack your things quickly!
The Deacon Hall has just issued a mission to go down the mountain - go to Bailu City to treat the city lord's daughter!
Xu Xingyao frowned: Mortal city? Why not find a local medicine repairer?
That's why it's strange.
Lin Che took out the mission scroll from her arms.
Several lines of writing appeared in the light and shadow projection: [The female owner of Bailu City was sixteen years old and suddenly suffered from hysteria. She went crazy when she saw the moon.
The local Xuanhu Pavilion was helpless and suspected of being invaded by evil spirits.
Remuneration: three hundred spiritual stones, plus a set of spiritual plant cultivation tools]
Spiritual plant cultivation tool? Xu Xingyao grabbed the scroll violently, and an additional clause appeared in the changing light and shadow: If the disease is cured, the city lord is willing to give three bottles of Hanyue Well water in the city to the rescuer.
Lin Che's fingertips focused on the last line: I heard that the water from that well can illuminate the essence of the moon at midnight.
He nuzzled at the silver dumplings, which was a great help to our little guys.
Xu Xingyao still asked, but the symptoms of the city lord's daughter...
